rules.description: A newly recorded application starts in the screening stage.
An application may move to interview only from screening.
An application may move to offer only from interview.
An application may be marked hired only from offer.
An application may be marked hired only when its job position has remaining headcount.
An application may be rejected only while it is in screening, interview, or offer.
A rejected application must have a rejection reason.
An application may be recorded only for an open job position.
A job position's filled headcount equals the number of its applications marked hired.
A job position's remaining headcount equals its required headcount minus its filled headcount.
A job position closes automatically when its filled headcount reaches its required headcount.
